title: Agent Invocation Detached Event
description: A running agent invocation outlived its lane's per-turn wall clock and the Hermes gateway gave its slot back instead of stopping it (interactive lane, extra.interactive.detach_on_timeout). The turn keeps running in the same Hermes session; its command stays un-acked and its execution journal row stays 'started' with detached_at set. Not terminal: the same command later closes with exactly one bloodbank.agent.invocation.completed or .failed, which carries detached: true. A turn still running at ceiling_seconds after dispatch is stopped and fails with error_code turn_timeout and timeout_source detached_ceiling. At most once per attempt; between agent.invocation.started and the terminal fact. Same correlationid, causationid = the invocation.started event. For a voice memo this means the reply arrives late: consumers keep waiting (do not re-dispatch the prompt) and speak the answer when the terminal fact lands. See bloodbank/docs/interactive-command-lane.md section 9.

command_id.description: command_id of the bloodbank.agent.invocation.invoke (or .start) command this turn runs.

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds between dispatching the turn to Hermes and detaching it (the lane limit, give or take the event loop).

timeout_seconds.description: The lane's turn_timeout_seconds that expired. Only the lane limit detaches; a shorter data.deadline_seconds from the command still stops the turn (turn_timeout, timeout_source envelope).

ceiling_seconds.description: Seconds after dispatch at which a still-running detached turn is stopped (extra.interactive.detached_ceiling_seconds, 2700 by default).

detached_count.description: Detached turns running on this lane right now, this one included.

max_detached.description: How many turns the lane lets run detached at once; past it a turn at the lane limit is stopped as before.

context.description: Echo of the originating command's data.context, verbatim (a voice memo's carries memo_id). Omitted when the command carried no context.

lane.description: Delivery lane of the originating command: batch (bloodbank.agent.invocation.start) or interactive (bloodbank.agent.invocation.invoke).
